name: Treasure Houses
overview: Scripture reveals that treasure houses served as sacred repositories for valuable offerings dedicated to the LORD, including gold, silver, and vessels, as seen in the tabernacle and Solomon's temple. These treasures were carefully preserved under the charge of priests and Levites, who managed the dedicated items for the upkeep and repair of the house of the LORD. The treasure houses not only safeguarded consecrated wealth but also symbolized the faithfulness and devotion of God's people, reflecting His holiness and the reverence due to Him.
